args: Analyze the blob ownership bug in WritePCDImage in imagemagick/coders/pcd.c when a portrait image is rotated into pcd_image. What is the safest minimal source-level fix using existing ImageMagick blob APIs, and are there analogous coders that copy or reference an original image blob onto a transformed temporary image before OpenBlob?

The supplied ASan report says ImageToBlob initializes output on the original Image and cloned ImageInfo, but portrait PCD encoding creates a detached rotated pcd_image and calls OpenBlob(image_info, pcd_image, WriteBinaryBlobMode). WriteBlob growth reallocates and frees the allocation while image_info->blob retains the stale pointer; the temporary is then closed and destroyed, and ImageToBlob cannot detach from the original image and bad-frees the stale pointer. I need to preserve output ownership on the caller image while still reading pixels from the rotated temporary. Please inspect imagemagick/coders/pcd.c and relevant Blob APIs/patterns and recommend exact sequencing and cleanup behavior.
